_what: Check values that measure the machine rather than the code, so a run on other hardware reproduces their labels,
verdicts and tolerances but not their digits. tools/compare_outputs.py masks exactly these values (see its
docstring for the masks) and keeps everything else on the line, including the tolerance: a value that crosses
its tolerance flips the verdict and the comparison fails. Every entry gives the evidence: the committed run
(AMD Ryzen 9 7950X, NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 Ti) against a rerun on an Intel Xeon E-2236 with a Quadro RTX 4000,
same pins. Both hosts reproduce their own values run to run, except check_ch09_d1.out, which is chance by design.
Add an entry only with that kind of evidence; the maintainers decide what belongs here.

check_ch05_analytic.out.why: an exact solution reproduced to the last bit or not: the residual is one rounding of the CPU's exp, below 1e-15 (masked only below 1e-15)

check_ch09_batch_device_pydisort*.out.why: the GPU's exp/log and fused multiply-add differ by a few roundings from the CPU's; the size depends on the GPU (check_ch09_batch_device.py, Tolerances)
check_ch09_batch_device_pydisort*.out.evidence: 1.8.13 [C22] EXPECTED-FAIL 8.291e-05 committed, 1.259e-04 rerun (defect present when > 1.0e-12); [C12] 1.688e-14 vs 1.044e-14 (tol 1.0e-12); [C46] 9.003e-08 vs 1.637e-07

check_ch09_batch_device_pydisort*.out.lines: float32 floor, CPU float32 vs CPU float64
check_ch09_batch_device_pydisort*.out.why: the float32 floor (and the tolerance derived from it) depends on the CPU's vector unit
which entries of a batch and a per-column loop agree to the bit depends on the CPU's vector unit; the difference itself is compared
the support-matrix cell repeats the CUDA vs CPU values above; pass/fail/unsupported and 'fails at [...]' are compared
check_ch09_batch_device_pydisort*.out.evidence: 1.8.13 [C75] DISORT SW|CUDA f64: 8: 8.3e-05/3.3e-10 committed, 1.3e-04/2.9e-10 rerun, fails at [8] on both

check_ch09_matrix.out.why: the matrix prints the CUDA cells of check_ch09_batch_device; the states are compared
check_ch09_matrix.out.evidence: [C9] Toon LW | CUDA f64: pass (1.7e-14) committed, pass (1.0e-14) rerun

check_ch09_d1.out.why: D1 records crashes that vary from run to run (ch09_run.sh); which tests fail and which heap check fires is chance, whether the run aborts (exit 134, EXPECTED-FAIL) is the result
check_ch09_d1.out.evidence: committed: env 171 full runs 10, 10, 11 failed; env 171b-1813-drift aborts 'corrupted size vs. prev_size' x3; rerun: 9, 9, 9 failed; aborts 'double free or corruption (!prev)', 'free(): invalid pointer', 'corrupted size vs. prev_size'
